malilib-ui.name: Philia UI
malilib-ui.description: Modernized configuration screens for the masa mod family.
malilib-ui.config.enabled.comment: Whether the modernized configuration screens are enabled.
malilib-ui.config.comment.builderMaster: Created by the config builder; turning it off hides the two examples below.
malilib-ui.config.comment.builderChild: Visibility is registered through the builder visibleWhen().
malilib-ui.config.comment.builderValue: Integer control example, also depends on the builder master switch.
malilib-ui.config.comment.testModeA: Enables the Mode A specific option.
malilib-ui.config.comment.testModeAOptio: Visible only while the Mode A switch is enabled.
malilib-ui.config.comment.testModeB: Enables the Mode B specific text option.
malilib-ui.config.comment.testModeBText: Visible only while the Mode B switch is enabled.
malilib-ui.config.comment.enabled: Whether the masa config screens are restyled.
malilib-ui.config.comment.semiTransparen: Whether the background panels are semi-transparent.
malilib-ui.config.comment.backgroundOpac: Opacity of the background panels (0-100, higher means less transparent; 0 is fully transparent, default 45 lets the world show through).
malilib-ui.config.comment.sidebarWidth: Width of the left TAB rail in pixels (90-260; it shrinks automatically when the window is too narrow).
malilib-ui.config.comment.badgeText: Text shown in the top-left badge. Leave empty to use the default.
malilib-ui.config.comment.badgeIcon: Path to a PNG icon for the top-left badge. Absolute, or relative to the malilib config directory. Leave empty for no icon.
malilib-ui.config.comment.testMaster: When disabled, all test options that depend on it are hidden.
malilib-ui.config.comment.testChildA: Visible only while the test master switch is enabled.
malilib-ui.config.comment.testChildB: Visible only while the test master switch is enabled.
malilib-ui.config.comment.testGrandchild: Multi-level dependency example: visible only when both the master switch and Child A are enabled.
malilib-ui.config.comment.widgetBoolean: Basic on/off switch, click to toggle.
malilib-ui.config.comment.widgetInteger: Integer slider; use the button to type an exact value.
malilib-ui.config.comment.widgetColor: Color preview / editor, click to open the color picker.
malilib-ui.config.comment.widgetHotkey: Keybind control, click and press a key to change it.
malilib-ui.config.comment.widgetStringLi: Multi-line string list, click to open the editor dialog.
malilib-ui.config.comment.widgetOptionLi: Dropdown option list, click to cycle through options.
malilib-ui.config.comment.widgetBooleanH: Combined boolean switch and keybind control.
malilib-ui.config.comment.flatEnabled: Switch on the no-group page (created directly by the factory, flat list).
malilib-ui.config.comment.flatCount: Integer entry on the no-group page.
malilib-ui.config.comment.flatChild: Shown dynamically when the switch above is enabled.
malilib-ui.config.comment.flatText: String entry on the no-group page.
